options.reason: Bars make the exact annual totals easy to compare across years.
options.interpretation: This bar chart answers how many pedestrians were killed in each requested year by summing the crash-level pedestrian-fatality counts; it shows annual totals from 2013 through 2025. It is a defensible framing because the requested quantity is a yearly count, and the plotted values are the direct annual sums. It does not show where or why those deaths occurred. It excludes 100545 rows dated before 2013 (4.43% of all file rows, all in the partial 2012 coverage), 36424 rows dated in 2026 (1.61% of all file rows, 2026 is covered only through 2026-06-11), and no rows for NULL crash dates or NULL pedestrian-fatality counts.
